scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline story painting for chapter 3, “The Old Road,” in The Red Notebook
Primary request: depict the end of paragraph 1: Mika and librarian Ms Sato compare the red notebook's small black line with a town map; the line seems to end at the second bend on an old mountain road.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved simple inline style reference; Image 2 guides Mika's character identity and palette only.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet library table on a rainy morning, with a folded town map and an open plain red notebook; a cool window and a few shelves remain softly simplified behind them.
Subject: Mika, dark-haired and wearing her muted teal cardigan over ivory, studies the page beside Ms Sato, an older librarian with grey hair and a restrained rust scarf. Sato's hand traces a winding route on the map while Mika notices one short dark line in the notebook. On the map, the simple route ends at the second of three bends near a small stream crossing. No other marks or labels.
Style/medium: gentle children's picture-book painting in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simplified background; distinctly simpler than the textured cover.
Composition/framing: medium-wide landscape about 12:7, Mika and Sato readable at the table, notebook and map form the focal point, two or three broad depth layers.
Lighting/mood: soft grey morning light with warm indoor accents, focused and quietly tense.
Color palette: warm ivory, midnight indigo, muted teal, restrained rust red and soft grey.
Constraints: show only the map-and-notebook discovery from paragraph 1. The notebook and map contain no words, letters, numbers, labels or symbols beyond the single simple route line. No title, border, frame or watermark.
Avoid: mountain rescue, landslide, missing child, future events, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense brush texture, cluttered background.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline story painting for chapter 3, “The Old Road,” in The Red Notebook
Primary request: depict the end of paragraph 0: a teacher has finally answered the phone, but the school bus has already left and the teacher is trying repeatedly to reach its driver before it continues into the mountains.
Reference guidance: no image files are attached to this generation. Describe the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simplified background, and two or three broad depth layers. The chapter cover informs Mika’s identity and palette only: dark hair tied back, muted teal cardigan and ivory top.
Scene/backdrop: a modest school entrance on a rainy grey morning, with a simple school facade and a view toward a distant green mountain road. Use only a few soft rain strokes and broad background shapes.
Subject: an adult teacher stands under the school entrance roof holding a phone and looking toward a small yellow school bus already moving away along the road. A few indistinct child silhouettes sit inside; no face or sign is emphasized. The bus is safe and travelling normally.
Style/medium: gentle hand-painted children’s picture-book art in the simple Kasa Jizō inline style, flatter and quieter than the textured chapter cover; smooth colour planes, soft contours, restrained detail and readable silhouettes.
Composition/framing: landscape about 12:7, medium-wide, teacher near the school entrance in the foreground and the yellow bus small but clear on the winding road beyond; two or three broad depth layers.
Lighting/mood: cool rainy morning, quiet urgency without panic.
Color palette: muted teal, warm ivory, midnight indigo, soft sage, slate grey and a restrained yellow accent on the bus.
Constraints: depict only the setup in paragraph 0. The bus has not reached a bend or met any danger. No landslide, bridge, crack, police, injuries, text, lettering, numbers, signs, labels, title, border, frame or watermark.
Avoid: dramatic disaster, crowded schoolyard, detailed vehicle dashboard, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense brush texture, heavy rain detail, clutter.
